description: Reads robots.txt for each AI crawler (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended…) and fetches the homepage as GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot to see whether a bot wall blocks them. A few seconds; does not count as an audit.

domain.description: A public hostname or URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/pricing (the host is used).

name: crawler_check
title: Which AI crawlers can read this domain?
